public_prior: The code-effect mapping is one of six bijections. Each algorithm receives the same prior, public effect vocabulary, observed fitting-graph code patterns and probe allowance.
posterior: Only effects agreed by all posterior-consistent mappings can be used to predict. Remaining ambiguity must cause whole-graph abstention.
policy_objective: Bayesian design maximizes expected all-claims-correct proportion on fitting graph structures, averaging over legal mapping hypotheses. Fitting labels and checking examples are unavailable to selectors.
boundaries: Development-only source. No new prospective source generation.
No scientific claim based solely on synthetic same-family cases.
advancement: A parity or loss to exact Bayesian policy is a negative. Do not claim causal reasoning or unfamiliar transfer.
